title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
slides: Why is Signal blocking Gemini and Siri from your screen?
Google's AI tools scan on-screen content for context
Signal claims those scans capture encrypted chats unprotected
iPhone users using Gemini extensions lose Signal's privacy promise
Check your AI screen-access settings before enabling extensions
thread_text:
1. Your private chats exposed

Signal says Google's screen-reading tools can grab content from encrypted conversations. The problem starts the moment you enable an AI extension.

2. How the scanning works

Gemini and Siri read what's on your display to build context for answers. That includes anything visible in the Signal app.

3. The encryption gap

Signal encrypts messages in transit, but once they're rendered on screen, they're just text. The AI scanner sees them as readable content.

4. iPhone users at risk

If you use Gemini extensions on iOS, Signal warns your privacy promise no longer holds. The protection you assumed is quietly gone.

5. Check your settings now

Open your AI assistant's extension settings and disable screen access for messaging apps. Do it before your next private conversation.
